name: sourcepoint-top
comment: Top-frame companion to Sourcepoint-frame. The message UI lives in a cross-origin iframe, so the top frame cannot tell an ordinary notice from a 'consent or pay' wall that Sourcepoint-frame has to bail on; hide it either way and undo the scroll lock. Hiding uses visibility rather than display so the iframe keeps its layout and the frame rule can still complete a real rejection underneath, with z-index and pointer-events mirroring the built-in hide step. The scroll lock is undone twice over: removeClass restores each site's own layout in the normal case, and the stylesheet neutralises the lock declarations if Sourcepoint re-adds the class later (it does so on pageshow after a back/forward restore, which autoconsent does not re-run for).

optOut.stylesheet: div[id^='sp_message_container_'] { visibility: hidden !important; z-index: -1 !important; pointer-events: none !important; }

html.sp-message-open { height: auto !important; width: auto !important; } html.sp-message-open body { position: relative !important; overflow: auto !important; margin-top: 0 !important; top: auto !important; left: auto !important; right: auto !important; }
